items.prompt: Remove which endings at next start s?

options.why: Strictly earlier endings omit sessions ending exactly at s, though half-open endpoints allow reuse then.
These are sessions that have not yet finished at s; removing them would undercount overlap.
Every ending at or before s is finished, including ties, so all such entries leave the active heap.
An arbitrary removal can drop a live session while leaving a finished one in the active set.

items.explanation: Release all finished sessions including ties.
